'''Cancelled Virtual Sets''' are [[Players Committee]] Virtual products that were planned or listed but never released in the form described. Decipher expansions announced after [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] and never published are covered at [[Cancelled Expansions]].

== [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]] ==

[[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]] was a planned Original-era Virtual Set that was never released. A Polish fan overview of the Virtual Sets marks it ''niewydany'' (unreleased), the only entry so marked.<ref name="pl-vs">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG &mdash; Virtual Sets], Bastion Polskich Fan&oacute;w Star Wars (star-wars.pl). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192957/https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Internet Archive].</ref>

The modern [[Virtual Set 19]], a Rebels-themed Current Virtual set announced in August 2022, is a different product.<ref name="vs19-modern">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived/ The Beautiful and Thematic Virtual Set 19 Has Arrived], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020230859/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Virtual Set 18: Fifth Anthology ==

Original-era '''Virtual Set 18: Fifth Anthology''' was not cancelled: its previewed cards were released in Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV. It was previewed on 8 June 2009 for a July 2009 premiere, with six cards marked Virtual Set 18.<ref name="pl-fifth">[https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Preview Fifth Anthology], star-wars.pl, 8 June 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250620070924/https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee's [[V-slips|virtual-slips]] page lists Legacy Virtual Sets VS1&ndash;VS17 only.<ref name="vslips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="vc17">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020214437/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The previewed titles appear in Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV, later [[Virtual Block 6]] (official text 4 September 2009). '''Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force''' (#67) and '''Maneuvering Flaps &amp; Nick Of Time''' (#81) carry the game text from the June preview.<ref name="vb6pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] (Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV; official text as of 4 September 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="vb6list">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html Virtual Block 6 cardlist], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013153655/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html Internet Archive].</ref> The Polish overview lists Fifth Anthology without the ''niewydany'' mark.<ref name="pl-vs" /> Virtual Block 1's introduction counts &ldquo;previous 18 virtual sets&rdquo;.<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The modern [[Virtual Set 18]] (released 21 April 2022) is a different Current Virtual product.

== Virtual Block 9.2 ==

Virtual Block 9.2 was not released in its planned form. Virtual Block 9.1 (''Republic at War'') shipped on 10 January 2014, and the virtual-slips page still lists both 9.1 and 9.2.<ref name="vslips" /> On 25 July 2014, announcing the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]], the Players Committee wrote: “9.2 will not be released in its current form. We are planning on releasing a mini, 12 card set for Worlds…”<ref name="reset-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format] (live) &mdash; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Wayback, 6 Mar 2017]; byline darkjediknight11, July 25th, 2014</ref>
